introHtml: Custom box buttons, stickers, and patches are a versatile promotional staple that packs a lot of personality into a small package. Unlike single loose buttons, our box sets come neatly packaged in a branded box, making them ideal for trade show giveaways, employee welcome kits, or retail point-of-sale items. You can choose from button cards, pride buttons, or heart-shaped designs, each customizable with your logo and message. Decoration options include full-color digital print on metal or paper inserts, ensuring your artwork pops. Bulk ordering keeps per-unit costs low while maximizing brand exposure every time someone opens the box.
